updates.how: The front corner scoop and furniture have been revised in conjunction with the front suspension fairings aiming at improved flow conditioning.
The rear corner furniture has been revised to achieve an improvement in flow conditioning as well as increased local load.
The diffuser geometry has been modified aiming at an improvement of flow conditioning and local load across the speed range.

updates.change: Additional vane on the endplate foot plate
updates.how: Taking the recently introduced front wing geometry, an option to operate with the tyre temperature turning vane has been added for evaluation, offering a tyre surface temperature measurement as well as more local load with similar flow stability.

The periphery of the gaitor has been revised to reduce the likelihood of tearing the elastomeric material during running by reducing the strain in the regions of highest deflection when steering lock is applied.

updates.reason: Performance – Local Load and Flow Conditioning
updates.change: Updated board brace layout, redesigned front floor leading edge reshaping of both inboard vertical and top horizontal board elements
updates.how: Key development features have focused on increasing floor downforce (on both front and rear parts) whilst also increasing energy levels and flow stability sent towards the back of the car

updates.reason: Performance – Local Load and Flow Conditioning
updates.change: Revised diffuser volume, expansion profile, fence loading and trailing edge outboard furniture
updates.how: Benefitting from improved onset flow quality, the diffuser expansion and overall geometry has been further optimized, and returns increased aerodynamic load in an efficient way
The front wing endplate plays an important role in managing the flow around the front tyres. These updates further improve the management of the flow field downstream.
The camber and chord of the rear wing flap elements has been modified to clean up the local flow and allow the wing to generate more load.

updates.change: Multiple changes including leading edge devices, board and floor edge
updates.how: A combination of developments across a number of key floor components which improves the overall flow management around the floor. This translates into an efficient downforce increase.
Working in combination with the updates made to the floor, the changes to the engine cover help manage the flow as it passes around the side of the car and towards the rear.
The revised front brake duct provides updated cooling characteristics together with associated aerodynamic performance, complementing the latest development steps introduced.
The updated floorboard geometry is intended to improve local flow conditioning and support the overall aerodynamic performance of the floor assembly.
The updated mirror stay geometry complements the revised front corner configuration and supports the overall aerodynamic performance of the car package introduced lately.
The rear floor corner has been redesigned to improve the local flowfield interaction with the rear corner while also increasing local load.
The second and third element flap of the rear wing have been redesigned to improve rear wing flow quality and overall load delivery.
Revised geometry improves flow conditioning to the rear of the car and reduces sensitivity to changes in car attitude, whilst retaining overall aerodynamic load

updates.change: Updated Sidepod Top Deck Cooling Louvres
updates.how: The sidepod top deck louvres have been updated to increase the power unit cooling capacity, whilst minimising the effect on aerodynamic performance
